about: Size caps in bytes (tools/kb/lifecycle.py, tests/test_kb_budget.py): each file and the whole of data/kb, from the sizes on 2026-11-20 plus 10%. news.json has room for its 8 weeks of digests, digest-history.json for its 52 lines, sweep.json (written by the monthly sweep) for the 805 URLs cited today. A file not listed gets `default`. Over: consolidate (merge, shorten, supersede, expire); raise a cap only for a new lane or real new coverage, and say why. 2026-11-23 (owner): dungeons.json and watch.json raised for the Forever dungeons coverage (PR #189) and the one-time baselines of 70 guides; classes, class-meta, game-rules and sources raised to current size plus 10% ahead of those guides' first weekly review. Total unchanged (1.9 MB used of 2.26 MB). 2026-11-25: rules.json raised for the gear advice's new content gates (content.raids_not_open, content.events_not_open, battleground.reputations).

foreverdb.about: ForeverDB.net's item sources (tools/kb/gates.py foreverdb_gate, not part of data/kb's total): the file's cap is its size on 2026-11-24 (1.35 MB) plus about 50% for new items, and the share of ForeverDB's own picks (tests/data/foreverdb-picks.json) that must keep a source (856 of 935 on 2026-11-24, 92%).
